stem: How many questions are there in the Life in the UK test?
explanation: The test has 24 multiple-choice questions and you have 45 minutes to answer them.
handbook_ref: Chapter 1 · Taking the Life in the UK test

stem: To pass the Life in the UK test you need to answer at least 75% of the questions correctly.
explanation: The pass mark is 75%, which means at least 18 of the 24 questions must be right.
handbook_ref: Chapter 1 · Taking the Life in the UK test
